chapters.title: A Claim Is Not Evidence
chapters.blurb: A builder being satisfied is a claim; a deterministic recording of the run is evidence — the one rule the whole repo serves.

chapters.title: The Builder's Workshop
chapters.blurb: Scratch probes in work slash, durable artifacts in evidence slash, the gate gauntlet, and the recorded final happy run.

chapters.title: The Critic Attacks
chapters.blurb: A fresh session fans out parallel critics: falsify, audit coverage, hunt mocks, sabotage a scratch worktree, fuzz, interrogate the recording.

chapters.title: The Budget and the Loud Stop
chapters.blurb: Reworks run in rounds of three, a progress judge rules on convergence between rounds, and ten attempts is the hard cap — then the loud stop.

chapters.title: Why the Critic Beats a Reviewer
chapters.blurb: A diff-reader grades the story of the change; the critic holds the Replay session, attacks it from six directions, and cross-examines its own findings.
